description.value:
As a bonus action, you enter a second stance—optionally entering your Forredari Stance in the same action—lasting 1 minute and granting the following while active:

  • Charging Wampa. Once per round, being forced to save against a force power increases your speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
  • Nexu Grin. When a creature within 10 feet of you makes a force attack roll against you or an ally by casting a force power, you may spend 1 focus point as a reaction to impose disadvantage on that roll; if it still misses and the higher of the two dice would also have missed, the caster can't cast that power again until it completes a short or long rest.
  • Screaming Squill. Once per turn, if a creature you hit is forced to make a Constitution save to maintain concentration on a force power, the DC equals your focus save DC instead, unless the normal DC would be higher.

Being incapacitated or dying ends these effects early. You can use this feature once between long rests; once spent, you may instead pay 1 focus point to use it again, though your maximum focus points then drop by 1 until your next long rest.
